newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price--USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price--USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 2,600 head were exported into the United States at Santa Teresa, N.M., with prices up from last week.
"Compared to last week, steer calves sold four to five cents higher and yearlings and calves weighing over 500 lbs sold firm," USDA said.
Trade was active and demand was good for calves and yearlings weighing under 500 lbs and the bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lbs.
Feeder steers weighing 300-400 lbs sold at prices between 78-88 cents/lb and those weighing 400-500 lbs were between 68-78 cents/lb, USDA said.
